description: OMENZ Time Zones: what time is it there, and is it a good time to reach them? Convert a time between up to 10 IANA zones (or now anywhere), with UTC offset, DST in effect, abbreviation, weekday and a business-hours check per zone (default 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri, adjustable), plus all_in_business_hours for scheduling across zones. Flags times that don't exist or happen twice around DST switches. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/time/convert, $0.002 via x402.)
